programme.title: Welcome to Marwen
programme.desc: Mark Hogancamp (Steve Carell) is an illustrator, known primarily for his World War II graphics.However, he hides quite an original preference.He is fascinated by women's shoes.At home, she has a large collection of high heels, sandals, flip-flops and many other shoes.His secret is revealed unexpectedly and causes great emotions.He is attacked by a group of neo-Nazis.The injuries are so severe that they result in loss of not only memory, but also the ability to speak and move.His artistic career is ruined.The man starts therapy, hoping to regain his former shape.However, he struggles with enormous trauma and mental problems.He finally manages to find a new passion.He constructs a village in the garden, which he names Marwen.Its inhabitants, the dolls, are modeled on real people from his life.It turns out that the mockup helps him deal with panic attacks.However, he still cannot forget his experiences.Meanwhile, a new neighbor, Nicol (Leslie Mann), moves in next door.The film is inspired by the true story of artist Mark Hogancamp.The town he built is located in Kingston.

programme.title: Bastille Day
programme.desc: On the eve of Bastille Day, an American thief living in Paris, Michael Mason (Richard Madden), steals a bag containing a teddy bear.Not knowing that there is a bomb hidden inside the toy, he takes the money and documents and throws the rest into a trash bin in a crowded Paris metro station.A few seconds later there is a huge explosion.Four people die.City surveillance footage reveals Michael's face.The police, considering him a terrorist, start searching for him.He is stopped by CIA agent Sean Briar (Idris Elba), who is just trying to find his way back to work after returning from Iraq.He brings the suspect to a secret interrogation room.Michael explains the misunderstanding and convinces that someone else is behind the attack.He and Sean have 24 hours to find the real culprits.The film was shot in 2015 and became even more relevant after the attacks in Paris.

programme.title: Laws of Man
programme.desc: A suspenseful story set in the paranoid climate of the Cold War era.The year is 1963. Two federal marshals are investigating a case in rural Nevada.They are on the trail of a sinister conspiracy.

programme.title: NO
programme.desc: Animal tamer OJ Haywood (Daniel Kaluuya) and his sister Emerald (Keke Palmer) live on a ranch in southern California where horses are trained for Hollywood film productions.They take over the business of their father, who died in suspicious circumstances.Problems are piling up for them.One day they become witnesses of inexplicable phenomena.Together with a former child star (Steven Yeun), an emcee at a family amusement park, they try to film supernatural incidents to make money by selling sensational materials.Their actions have unforeseen consequences.Director Jordan Peele made his debut in 2017 with the acclaimed thriller "Get Out!", for which he won an Oscar for the script.

programme.title: 28 Days Later...
programme.desc: A deadly virus was bred in one of the laboratories in Great Britain.A group of animal activists breaks in and frees the monkeys that were being studied.The animals, mad with rage, attack their saviors.The infected person loses control within 12 seconds and becomes a bloodthirsty beast.The epidemic is spreading extremely quickly throughout the country.28 days later, Jim (Cillian Murphy) wakes up from a coma while lying in the intensive care unit of a London hospital.Not understanding what happened, he wanders the deserted streets of the city.The terrified man is attacked by groups of angry people.He is saved from trouble by Selena (Naomie Harris) and Mark (Noah Huntley).All three escape from the city and end up at a military base commanded by Major Henry West (Christopher Eccleston).However, they are not safe there either.

programme.title: Towards the sun
programme.desc: The year 2057. People are increasingly concerned about what is happening to the Sun.It seems to be losing power, and the Earth dependent on it is gradually becoming covered with ice.Scientists are sending an expedition towards the Sun whose task is to place a powerful nuclear charge on its surface.Experts predict that such an explosion will stimulate the star's activity and thus save the world from destruction.After some time, however, it turns out that a similar mission had already taken place seven years earlier, but then none of the crew managed to return to Earth.This time, eight people are sent into space, commanded by the experienced Captain Kaneda.The Icarus II board includes, among others:Cassie, Capa, Corazon and Mace.It quickly turns out that someone is making every effort to prevent the expedition members from reaching their goal.Soon, one of the pilots makes a fatal mistake and deprives the crew of oxygen supplies.In addition, unexpectedly, the ship begins to receive warning signals from its predecessor.The situation is becoming more and more dramatic.

programme.title: Sellers 3
programme.desc: Randall (Jeff Anderson) has a heart attack.He goes to hospital.A sudden illness makes him take stock of his life.While looking for a new goal, he comes up with the idea of ​​making a film about the Quick Stop store.

programme.title: Her
programme.desc: Los Angeles.Theodore makes a living by writing letters to order.He experiences a painful divorce from Catherine.His friend Amy supports him in difficult times.He spends his free time playing computer games and occasional dates.One day he buys a new operating system that can meet all user needs.She uses the software's capabilities by communicating with a virtual character with a sensual voice, Samantha.He quickly realizes that this cybernetic consciousness understands him perfectly.He has great knowledge, sense of humor and feelings.Theodore realizes that he has met the ideal woman.Attempts are made to create an unconventional relationship.

programme.title: Esperando a Dalí
programme.desc: Barcelona, ​​1974, a period of intense opposition to Franco's dictatorship.Brothers Fernando (Ivan Massagué), a chef, and Alberto (Pol López), an activist, must hide from the authorities.They find shelter in Cadaqués, a picturesque seaside village that is also the home of the famous artist Salvador Dalí (Gal Soler).In this setting, the brothers meet Lola (Clara Ponsot), who helps them find work.Fernando, influenced by Dalí's works and his infatuation with women, finds a passion for creating unique dishes.The man's ambitions grow, especially when Jules (José Garcia), Lola's eccentric father, dreams of organizing a dinner for Dalí himself.Despite the difficulties, Fernando creates a culinary masterpiece that inspires a revolution in the world of taste, which leads to the creation of the famous Surreal restaurant.

programme.title: No Hit Wonder
programme.desc: After a failed suicide attempt, forgotten singer Daniel Nowak (Florian David Fitz) is sent to a closed psychiatric ward where the most serious cases are kept.He recalls the hit from years ago that brought him fame, reflects on his mistakes and thinks with regret about his current life, in which he earns money by performing in supermarkets.Doctor Lissi Waldstett (Nora Tschirner) engages a grief-stricken artist in a pioneering program in which the therapy of people with depression is based on music.Together they form a chorus of patients.They are joined by, among others:shy Elaha (Jerusha Wahlen) and retiree Helmut (Udo Samel).Their common trials bring them closer together, and Daniel has a chance to look at his life differently.

programme.title: And Just Like That...
programme.desc: Carrie Bradshaw (Sarah Jessica Parker) does not lose hope of finding the love of her life.She can count on the support of her friends.Continuation of "Sex and the City".

programme.title: Alita: Battle Angel
programme.desc: Alita (Rosa Salazar), a cyborg girl, wakes up from a coma.It turns out that he doesn't remember who he is or where he is.Doctor Ido (Christoph Waltz) subjected her to a series of tests that revealed that she was a young woman with a unique story.Wanting to protect her, he does not reveal the truth about her past.Alita must adapt to the conditions and rules of life in Scrap City.After some time, he regains his memory thanks to the help of his friend, Hugo (Keean Johnson).Then he realizes that he has incredible fighting skills.She must use them against the power that tries to control her.The film's director is Robert Rodriguez, known from "From Dusk Till Dawn" and "Machete".The script was written by the winner of three Oscars, James Cameron, who considered making "Alita" back in the 1990s. The film was based on the manga.

programme.title: The Greatest Showman
programme.desc: P. T. Barnum (Ellis Rubin) is the son of a tailor who works for the Hallett family.The boy falls in love with his employers' daughter, Charity (Skylar Dunn).They stay in touch for many years, and when they are adults, they get married.One day, Phineas (Hugh Jackman) loses his job.Wanting to ensure the happiness of his wife (Michelle Williams) and two daughters, a man opens a wax museum.When the idea turns out to be unsuccessful, he decides to show visitors live exhibits.He employs outstanding people - including: the acrobat Anne (Zendaya) and her brother W. D. (Yahya Abdul-Mateen II), the woman with the beard Lettie Lutz (Keala Settle) and Charles Stratton (Sam Humphrey).The show attracts a large audience but receives negative reviews;Barnum's museum is called a circus.To improve his reputation, the man invites Phillip Carlyle (Zac Efron) to cooperate with him.He soon meets Swedish singer Jenny Lind (Rebecca Ferguson).The artist's performance turns out to be a breakthrough for his career.

programme.title: A Big Bold Beautiful Journey
programme.desc: Sarah (Margot Robbie) and David (Colin Farrell) meet at a friend's wedding.They go on an expedition during which they relive the most important moments from their past.

programme.title: A Real Pain
programme.desc: American David Kaplan (Jesse Eisenberg) and his cousin Benji (Kieran Culkin) set off on an expedition to Poland.They want to honor the memory of their beloved grandmother Dora.They begin their tour of her home country by joining the team of British guide James (Will Sharpe).Members of the group with Jewish roots visit places related to the history and culture of their ancestors.During the journey, tensions grow between the young men resulting from their different approaches to life.The director and screenwriter of the comedy-drama is Jesse Eisenberg, who also starred in the main role.He called his film "a love letter to Poland".His acting duo, Kieran Culkin, was awarded a Golden Globe.The photos were shot, among others, in Warsaw and Lublin.

programme.title: Lovecraft Country
programme.desc: 1950s.Young black Atticus Freeman (Jonathan Majors), together with his uncle George (Courtney B. Vance) and friend Letitia Dandridge (Jurnee Smollett-Bell), sets off in search of his father (Michael Kenneth Williams).The man is missing and the three of them decide to find out what happened to him.Their journey leads through a prejudiced, racist America.Soon they will face forces that are out of this world, monsters that they had no idea existed.The series is based on the novel of the same title by Matt Ruff.

programme.title: Victor Frankenstein
programme.desc: Scientist Victor (James McAvoy) and his protégé Igor research immortality together.Over time, the consequences of their experiments become more and more terrifying.

programme.title: The Lighthouse
programme.desc: 1890s.A remote island off the coast of Maine.The lighthouse is guarded by two men.Thomas Wake (Willem Dafoe) is old, stubborn and struggling with a painful leg injury.The younger of them, Thomas Howard (Robert Pattinson), initially seems a bit more open due to his age.However, he hides a secret that made him choose to work in isolation.What they have in common is that they are twisted by life.They will have to spend four arduous weeks in each other's company.Over time, isolation from the world and weather conditions take their toll on them.Both lighthouse keepers are slowly losing their sanity.The director of this psychological horror film, which has received many awards and nominations, is Robert Eggers, the creator of the acclaimed film "The Witch: A New England Folk Tale".Jarin Blashke received Oscar and BAFTA nominations for best cinematography.

programme.title: Bring Her Back
programme.desc: After their father's death, the siblings, Andy and Piper, are placed in Laura's care.The boy begins to suspect that the woman is hiding some secrets.It soon comes to light that their guardian is planning a dark ritual.

programme.title: Freaky
programme.desc: Millie (Kathryn Newton) lives in a small American town and struggles with numerous problems.He can only count on a pair of loyal friends, Josh (Misha Osherovich) and Nyla (Celeste O'Connor).She is ridiculed by her peers and has just lost her father.To make matters worse, he becomes the target of a psychopath roaming the area, the Blissfield Butcher (Vince Vaughn).The bloody incident has surprising consequences - the girl, stabbed with an antique dagger on a moonlit night, magically switches bodies with her tormentor.In the morning he wakes up as a wanted murderer, and the Butcher can now go hunting in the form of a delicate blonde.Millie has only 24 hours to reverse the spell.Christopher Landon, the creator of "Die Another Day", pays tribute to the classics of horror cinema.He skillfully plays with convention, referring to "Halloween" or "Scream".

programme.title: Living
programme.desc: London, 1953. Rodney Williams (Bill Nighy) has been doing the same boring bureaucratic job for years.A lonely man feels that his life has been meaningless for a long time.One day he learns from the doctor that he has been diagnosed with incurable cancer.Desperate, he goes to a seaside town to commit suicide.However, he changes his mind and spends the night wandering around bars with a writer he meets there, Sutherland (Tom Burke).Back in London, Williams doesn't go to the office.He runs into Margaret Harris (Aimee Lou Wood), a much younger and energetic woman who once worked in his department.He becomes friends with her and she infects him with her enthusiasm.When the man's condition worsens, he decides to do something important.With the help of Peter Wakeling (Alex Sharp), a young idealist from his office, he wants to build a playground, the construction of which he himself had previously blocked.A remake of "The Brand of Death", a drama by Akira Kurosawa, inspired by Leo Tolstoy's short story "The Death of Ivan Ilyich".

programme.title: A Royal Affair
programme.desc: 18th century.The young English aristocrat Caroline Matilda of Hanover (Alicia Vikander) marries the Danish king Christian VII (Mikkel Boe Folsgaard) as part of a political alliance.A smart, well-read and beautiful girl tries to cope with her new role.However, she finds no happiness with her exalted husband who shows signs of mental illness.When the German doctor Johann Friedrich Struensee (Mads Mikkelsen), whom the monarch has absolute trust in, appears at the court, the royal wife treats him with reluctance.Over time, however, she discovers how much she has in common with a progressive doctor, a follower of the ideas of the Enlightenment and a liberal who read the books of Voltaire, Rousseau and Locke.The two begin a passionate affair.Struensee gains more and more power and, with the support of Karolina Matilda, carries out innovative reforms.He makes many enemies.The court dignitaries, who have so far manipulated the king, do not intend to accept the loss of influence.They plot to get rid of the queen's lover.

programme.title: Guess Who
programme.desc: Dark-skinned Percy (Bernie Mac) is the head of the Jones family and always knows what is best for his loved ones.He also has an opinion on what the future husband of his daughter, Theresa (Zoe Saldana), should be like.Unfortunately, so far none of her admirers have gained his recognition.When Theresa tells him about her new boyfriend, stockbroker Simon (Ashton Kutcher), her father finally seems to support her choice.However, at the first meeting, the good impression disappears.It turns out that Simon is... white.In addition, she does not ask Percy for her daughter's hand in marriage because he has already proposed to her.What's more, he wants to announce his engagement at the silver wedding of his future in-laws.Percy decides to make his daughter give up the marriage on her own.

programme.title: What Happens Later
programme.desc: The inveterate dreamer Willa (Meg Ryan) and the pessimist Bill (David Duchovny), who once had feelings for each other, meet by chance at the airport after many years.Their plans are thwarted by a massive snowstorm, which forces them to wait for the canceled flights to resume.They haven't seen each other for over two decades.She is a masseuse practicing spiritual rituals, he is a down-to-earth corporate employee.They didn't part peacefully, so even though a lot of time has passed, they have a lot of explaining to do.They start talking not only about their current lives, but also about their painful past.Willa is lonely, although she always wanted a family.Bill has a wife and a daughter, but not everything is perfect between them.Former lovers discuss why they went their separate ways.They wonder what would have happened if it hadn't happened.They have the opportunity to finally say to each other what has not been said out loud before.It turns out that they are still not indifferent to each other.Based on the play by Steven Dietz.

programme.title: Long Good Thursday
programme.desc: Finland.A widowed farmer becomes a model for the eccentric artist Saimi.A feeling develops between them.This does not please the man's adult sons, who are afraid of losing their property.

programme.title: Mountainhead
programme.desc: While a massive financial crisis is brewing around the world, billionaire Souper (Jason Schwartzman) invites three friends as rich as him - Randall (Steve Carell), Venis (Cory Michael Smith) and Jeff (Ramy Youssef) - to his spacious villa in the mountains.Their combined fortunes are worth $371 billion, but their guilt for the situation is zero.The men spend their time carefree, drinking alcohol and joking, as well as ironically commenting on suspicious scenes of street riots on TV or on the Internet.The feature-length directorial debut of Jesse Armstrong, the creator of "Succession" and seven-time Emmy winner.

programme.title: The Other Guys
programme.desc: Hot-tempered New York detective Terry Hoitz (Mark Wahlberg) dreams of his name going down in police history.Unfortunately, he is punitively delegated to office work.His dim-witted partner Allen Gamble (Will Ferrell) is not keen on catching criminals and would rather spend his days behind a desk.As a result, those with completely opposite characters do not like each other.However, both of them share a feeling of inferiority because they are still in the shadow of the local police celebrities: P.K.Highsmith (Samuel L. Jackson) and Christopher Danson (Dwayne Johnson).The opportunity to take their place comes sooner than they might expect.When the famous duo is killed in action, Terry and Allen face the opportunity of a lifetime.They are on the trail of a scandal involving multimillionaire David Ershon (Steve Coogan).If they manage to find evidence of a crime and catch the culprits, they will gain recognition and decorations.However, if they fail, they will face professional degradation.
